_comment: How each place of the catalogue's words-10.jsonl was settled before it went in config/figures-seen/: two readers read every place against its BSB verse, one asking whether the figure is plainly there and one whether the marked words, form and tags are right; a place both passed is kept as handed over, and any place either questioned was read a third time and kept, changed or dropped. A new form stands only where a reader proposed it. Places not read are held, not listed. Stray punctuation before marked words is trimmed, and Strong's tags that light the article (G3588) or the object marker (H0853), or number eight, the search's limit, are taken off as a stretch of words.

Then kept figures of speech were read again by two readers, a third settling any difference ("words re-read" counts them: those a sample showed at risk, such as wide spans, or those found only in the Hebrew or Greek that carry no tags): each kept as it was, cut to the words that carry the figure, or dropped ("words").

Then every kept refrain was read again by two readers, a third settling any difference, each looking up the other verses of the book where its words come back: each kept, cut to the words of the verse that come back, or dropped ("refrain").

Last, a sample of 25 kept places was read by two more readers, a third settling any split; the file goes in only when 24 or more pass, and any place that fails is dropped. "samples" lists each sample and its result.
A place whose verse already has the same form from an earlier file is left out here, since the earlier file's place stands ("same form already on this verse").
